title: IES Optimiser run options
description: Run-option structure only. CSV contents, hourly list lengths and the case-dependent meaning of options are checked by ies-optimiser validate CASE.json with those options.

carbon-constraint.description: Emissions cap, in kg CO2eq per MWh of annual primary electricity demand, applied to total system emissions. Any finite value; a negative cap requires net removal.
carbon-constraint.title: Carbon constraint

non-served-power-constraint.description: Cap on annual unmet electricity, as a fraction of annual electricity demand, in [0, 1].
non-served-power-constraint.title: Non served power constraint

hourly-coverage-floor.description: Minimum served share of electricity demand only in each hour: unmet[h] <= (1 - floor[h]) * demand[h]. Number, CSV path string, or list of numbers in [0, 1]; values used as given, never rescaled. A string is a path. Relative paths resolve against the input file directory or RunConfig.profile_base, never the working directory.
hourly-coverage-floor.title: Hourly coverage floor
